task: Lift, carry and place a clothes stand
protocol: Recorded iterations from one Codex session. Initial is a separate evaluation of the identical input reference. Final retains iteration 23; iteration 25 is the last tested candidate. Query excerpts and images are attributed to their original events.

chart_notes.error: Mean ADD for every recorded candidate versus refinement time. The line retains the lowest error so far; dots include unsuccessful revisions. Initial is a separate evaluation of the identical input reference.
chart_notes.path: Object-center paths in the world XY plane. Height and orientation also contribute to ADD.

stages.label: Initial
stages.quote: The supplied initial pose has a foot about 3.6 cm below the floor and a hand/object overlap of about 7.5 mm. I’m correcting those before any simulation. The target carries the clothes stand roughly 1.2 m while lifting and rotating it, so establishing a valid grasp is the first major challenge.
stages.full_message: The supplied initial pose has a foot about 3.6 cm below the floor and a hand/object overlap of about 7.5 mm. I’m correcting those before any simulation. The target carries the clothes stand roughly 1.2 m while lifting and rotating it, so establishing a valid grasp is the first major challenge.

queries.label: Inspect the input pose
queries.detail: The agent reports the initial geometric checks before running its first candidate. The displayed rollout and ADD are a separate evaluation of the identical input arrays.
queries.raw:
source_floor contact distance (m): -0.036140079959423185
object contact distance (m): -0.007477653725577847

stages.label: Iter. 1
stages.quote: The first rollout kept the robot upright, but the grasp failed: the hand pushed the stand over instead of lifting it.
stages.full_message: The first rollout kept the robot upright, but the grasp failed: the hand pushed the stand over instead of lifting it. I’m inspecting the contact sequence and adjusting the finger closure and palm placement before testing the full carry again.

queries.label: Contact sequence
queries.detail: Object poses, finger closure, arm joints and contact forces sampled through the first two seconds.

stages.label: Iter. 2
stages.quote: The revised grasp lifted the stand briefly and reduced mean ADD to 0.353 m, but it slipped and lost rotational control.
stages.full_message: The revised grasp lifted the stand briefly and reduced mean ADD to 0.353 m, but it slipped and lost rotational control. The robot stayed upright. I’m testing a second hand on the pole to resist that rotation and maintain contact through the lift and turn.

queries.label: Fingertip–object clearances
queries.detail: Geometry-distance checks during the revised grasp fit.

stages.label: Iter. 3
stages.quote: The two-hand initial state now passes the checks: no active penetrations, no joint-limit violations, and the object pose and zero velocity are unchanged.
stages.full_message: The two-hand initial state now passes the checks: no active penetrations, no joint-limit violations, and the object pose and zero velocity are unchanged. I’ve also inspected the rendered posture. The next rollout will test whether this grasp holds through the full translation and rotation.

queries.label: Two-hand pose checks
queries.detail: Contact and joint-limit checks on the proposed two-hand starting pose.

stages.label: Iter. N
stages.quote: I’m stopping the remaining search and saving the best verified submission.
stages.full_message: I’m stopping the remaining search and saving the best verified submission. Its full replay reproduced the scores exactly, and the final stand is supported by the floor with zero robot contact.

queries.label: Compare the last candidates
queries.detail: The final parameter sweep is scored against the same object trajectory. The agent retains the earlier, lower-error candidate.

stages.image_label: Earlier inspection of the retained candidate

stages.label: Final
stages.quote: The hand loses contact around 10 seconds, and the stand remains independently supported through the 14-second finish.
stages.full_message: The latest rollout completes the carry and sets the stand down without a fall or drop. Mean errors are 0.063 m ADD, 0.040 m position, and 7.70° orientation. The hand loses contact around 10 seconds, and the stand remains independently supported through the 14-second finish. I’m running the final reproducibility check and saving the submission.

queries.label: Verify independent support
queries.detail: End-of-rollout checks of floor support, robot contact and object velocity.
